title: (No AI) OpenAI employee arrested for allegedly planting a bug in a conference room
author: Emma Roth
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/03/STK155_OPEN_AI_CVirginia__C.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

An OpenAI engineer was arrested after [the company said it discovered](https://x.com/OpenAINewsroom/status/2110095403198849132?s=20) a "sophisticated recording device" hidden in one of its offices. The employee was identified as Abdulrahman Alfozan, a 35-year-old Saudi national. Alfozan is charged with using or endeavoring to use a device to intercept oral communications, [according to a press release from the Department of Justice](https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/saudi-national-arrested-installing-surreptitious-audio-recording-device-openai).

OpenAI's post about the incident says it used its AI models to "understand the device and where it had come from, identifying that a specific employee had planted it a few days earlier."

![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/Screenshot-2026-10-13-at-5.24.10-PM.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

As noted by the DOJ, OpenAI found the device plugged into a TV's USB port in an executiv …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1010642/openai-employee-arrested-recording-device)

title: (No AI) Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents
author: Mia Sato
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/gettyimages-2225304503.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

CANADA - 2025/07/20: In this photo illustration, the Shopify logo is seen displayed on a smartphone screen. (Photo Illustration by Thomas Fuller/SOPA Images/LightRocket via Getty Images)

More AI agents will soon be able to browse and purchase from Shopify listings, marking an expansion of the company's agentic commerce ambitions.

Shopify [announced](https://x.com/benjaminsehl/status/2110101061499539825) Tuesday it will let shoppers [configure their AI agents](https://shop.md/) to purchase products on their behalf, giving more agents access to over a billion listings in Shopify's catalog. (The catalog consists of both items on and off Shopify storefronts.) In September, Shopify [announced](https://www.wsj.com/tech/shopify-to-use-metas-muse-for-agentic-checkout-d23947c0) it was partnering with Meta to allow its Muse agent to browse and purchase items on a human's behalf; now, shoppers can use any agent without a partnership integration.

To set up the feature, customers connect an …
